requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-4231-4452-5291--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Rukarumel, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Cursed Mirror. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Rukarumel, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

5254-8122-8249.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
You don't control an Army, or the only Army you do control is the creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-8122-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another creature with power 4 or greater. If you control an Army, ensure to sacrifice that creature.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token and putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.
5254-8122-8249.notes: The Orc Army will become a 5/5 due to the counters and the buff provided by The Muckslinger Gang.

1349-3899-6854.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken creature with a coin counter on it.
1349-3899-6854.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the creature with a coin counter on it.
When the creature dies, Athreos's second ability and Host of the Hereafter's ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter onto itself as well as +1/+1 counters if those were present.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 1.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Host of the Hereafter.
When Host of the Hereafter dies, it and Athreos's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Host of the Hereafter trigger, putting a coin counter and +1/+1 counters onto the other nontoken creature.
Resolve the Athreos trigger, returning Host of the Hereafter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability from step 6.
Repeat.

1170-2146-3698-5131--202.easyPrerequisites:
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
"Artifact" chosen with Cloud Key
1170-2146-3698-5131--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cloud Key.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell. When the artifact enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing the artifact.
Repeat.

570-4067-7890.easyPrerequisites: Faeburrow Elder does not have summoning sickness.
570-4067-7890.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}{W}
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-3738-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sightless Ghoul
When Sightless Ghoul dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Repeat.
2034-3738-6972.notes: If Sightless Ghoul starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1687-5231-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Siona triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

225-539-3634-4249.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to blue is at least 6.
225-539-3634-4249.description:
Activate Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least six {U}
Cast Venser by paying its mana cost.
When Venser enters as a land due to Ashaya, it and Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Resolve the Venser trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx.
Repeat.
225-539-3634-4249.notes: Once you have infinite mana, Stone-Seeder Hierophant can either tap for {G} or untap other nontoken creatures and/or lands you control.

560-2457-4289-6965.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating a 1/1 Soldier and a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Activate the Insect and Soldier by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

570-1978-5143.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three colors among permanents you control.

2173-2448-5220-6273.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
2173-2448-5220-6273.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Embalmed Ascendant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Embalmed Ascendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

2060-2919-4222-5027.notablePrerequisites: You've cast a spell this turn.
2060-2919-4222-5027.description:
Activate Gnostro by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Gnostro.
Repeat.

654-2034-5003-6644.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise, adding {C}{C}.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

654-678-5147-6644.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
When the Treasures enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers ten times, untapping the Treasures.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate eight Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Ancient Adamantoise by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more charge counters on it

198-2909-4067-6571.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Shantotto triggers, giving it +4/+0 until end of turn and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve Mind Games.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Repeat.

1399-1606-4249-4875.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to green is at least four.
1399-1606-4249-4875.description:
Activate Nykthos by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Nykthos.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

907-1479-6529.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
907-1479-6529.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it, Curse of the Restless Dead, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Curse of the Restless Dead trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters the battlefield, it and Curse of the Restless Dead trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

969-1563-2457-4365.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2.

1778-2438-5220-5683.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Memnite.
When Memnite dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Memnite from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Memnite and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat.

864-2061-5733.notablePrerequisites: You control a Rogue that does not have summoning sickness and that cannot be blocked by an opponent.
864-2061-5733.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Extravagant Replication triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Witness.
When the Eternal Witness token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

24-690-5644.description:
Cast Wheel of Misfortune by paying {2}{R}.
Judith triggers, giving Wheel of Misfortune deathtouch and lifelink.
Resolve Wheel of Misfortune, choosing an arbitrarily large number.
If you didn't choose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals damage equal to the highest number chosen to each player that chose it, causing those players to lose the game due to having 0 or less life.
If you chose the largest number, Wheel of Misfortune deals that much damage to you and causes you to gain that much life.
Sanguine Bond triggers, causing an opponent to lose lfie equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

2097-5436-5742-5743.description:
Activate Witch-king of Angmar by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Witch-king of Angmar ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1887-2499-3484-5391.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
1887-2499-3484-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a tapped 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

647-2155-3259.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature with the greatest power among creatures on the battlefield.
647-2155-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
647-2155-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Éomer of the Riddermark as attackers.
Éomer of the Riddermark triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

803-1641-2034-3263.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Promised Kannushi, adding {2}.
When Promised Kannushi dies, its soulshift ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Promised Kannushi by paying {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1976-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Harnfel by discarding a card, exiling the top two cards of your library and allowing you to cast them this turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1530-2334-3544-5049.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
1530-2334-3544-5049.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turh after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Soulherder's second ability triggers, blinking Auramancer.
When Auramancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

643-1295-3202-4219-4926.description:
Cast Wingmantle Chaplain by paying {3}{W}.
Wingmantle Chaplain's ETB ability and Dormant Sliver each trigger.
Resolve Dormant Sliver's trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve Wingmantle Chaplain's trigger, creating a 1/1 Sliver token with defender for each creature with defender you control.
Wingmantle Chaplain's last ability and Dormant Sliver each trigger once for each token created; put them on the stack in any order.
Resolve a Dormant Sliver trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve a Wingmantle Chaplain trigger, creating a 1/1 Sliver token with defender.
Repeat steps 5 through 7 until there are no cards in your library.
Put Wingmantle Chaplain's and Dormant Sliver's triggers on the stack in any order.
In response, cast Savage Summoning by paying {G}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}.
Thassa's Oracle enters the battlefield and triggers.

1409-1977.notablePrerequisites: Deadeye Navigator is paired with Tivit.
1409-1977.description:
Activate Tivit by paying {1}{U}, blinking itself.
Tivit enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability.
Resolve the Tivit trigger, creating at least two Treasure tokens and at least one additional Clue or Treasure token of your opponent' choosing.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Tivit.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

914-1651-3094.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least four artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-1651-3094.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Dockside Extortionist's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Dockside Extortionist's trigger, creating at least four Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {2}.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Treasures, untapping Lithoform Engine.
Repeat from step 3.
If opponents control five or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

933-2104-2493.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, taking an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
